note: Both sets extract the same six title-block facts with identical values and supporting quotes, so neither contains invented or misread data. Set A binds sheet number and sheet title to the sheet entity and lot number to the project, which is more precise and faithful to the title block layout. Set B labels every field as belonging to the 'document', which is vaguer and loses the sheet-level binding, though not outright wrong. Overall Set A is marginally better on entity/property binding while both are factually correct.
